title: Ecosystem Dynamics and Energy Transfers (Day 85)
description: Analyze the interdependent relationships between living organisms and environmental factors.
concept: Ecosystem energy profiles flow consistently through structured ecological levels.
bullets: Primary producers synthesize chemical energy directly via organic inputs or solar paths.
Decomposers process dead biomass matter back into bio-available soils.
Environmental shifts trigger immediate changes across structural community profiles.
cross_reference: Genesis 1:25 — And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind.
